opening.argument: The material is plainly instructional, presenting a Power BI course that covers business-intelligence fundamentals, Power BI concepts, report creation, and interview questions. The speaker explains that the introductory module covers the importance of BI and the available tools, while later instruction addresses building reports in Power BI Desktop and publishing a report to a workspace. The offer is identified as a four-week instructor-led online course with assignments and project work, alongside a promotional code, which indicates ordinary commercial training promotion. Nothing described involves deceptive claims, a request for credentials, losses, or a harmful condition attached to engagement.

citations.quote: Power BI Full Course - Learn Power BI in 4 Hours | Power BI Tutorial for Beginners | Edureka
The first module which is an introduction to Power BI will help you understand the importance. Of BI, the different tools that are there and why you should go for Power BI.
Power BI desktop is where you actually do all your. Development stuff. That is where you actually build your reports.
This is a 4 Week Instructor led Online Course, 20 hours of assignment and 20 hours of project work
